tagline: The Safest Provider of Natural Gas Services
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. Capex is selected as the hero KPI because it reflects the primary driver of the financial trajectory through the massive investment program in safety and reliability from 2026 to 2030.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (2026-2030)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested annually to modernize natural gas distribution infrastructure and enhance safety and reliability.
kpis.description: From 2026 to 2030, ATO plans to spend approximately $26 billion, with over 80% allocated to safety and reliability projects.
kpis.signal: Announced $26 billion, 5-year program dedicated to safety and reliability.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The company relies on a skilled workforce to maintain safe and reliable operations.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount in a human capital-intensive sector.

kpis.name: Customer Base Served
kpis.explanation: Number of residential, commercial, public authority, and industrial customers served across the eight operating states.
kpis.description: Atmos Energy serves approximately 3.4 million residential, commercial, public authority, and industrial customers across eight states.
kpis.signal: Large and stable customer base reflecting geographic reach and market positioning.

ai_positioning.summary: Atmos Energy does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a technological or operational lever.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning, or advanced automation tools in the Business, MD&A, or Risk sections.
Cited innovations focus on safety, infrastructure modernization, and regulatory compliance, with no connection to AI.
Cyber risks are addressed, but without reference to threats specific to AI or autonomous systems.
